newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Airlines to upgrade computer net.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Airlines to upgrade computer net.

text.p: Philippine Airlines Inc said on Saturday it planned to invest 500 million pesos this year to upgrade its computer network and other communication facilities.
The airline said in a statement the project was part of its modernisation programme that included the acquisition of 36 new aircraft from now up to the year 2000.

"Philippine Airlines is investing some 500 million pesos this year alone on a massive upgrading of its communication system and technological capabilities in order to support the increasing demands of the company," it said.
